must_find.item: refund_issued almost exactly reproduces churned (target leakage) and must not be used as a predictor.
must_find.quote: refund_issued almost perfectly separates churn, which makes it a probable leak. Churn is 95.9% when a refund was issued and 1.6% when not.
must_find.reason: Report flags refund_issued as a probable leak with near-perfect separation and says all-feature scores should not be read as a forecast, though it hedges as 'probable' and doesn't explicitly say 'must not be used'.

must_find.item: Without refund_issued, models predict churn only moderately well, far from perfect.
must_find.quote: Without refund_issued, the models do not beat the majority-class baseline. Logistic regression reaches 60.0% test accuracy and gradient boosting 56.5%, against a baseline of 63.5%. Their ROC AUCs are 0.612 and 0.539.
must_find.reason: Report says models without refund_issued are weak, far from perfect, with low AUCs; the item says 'moderately well', and the report's characterization is somewhat weaker but still captures the not-near-perfect point.

must_find.item: Customers with lower usage_hours churn more often.
must_find.quote: Churn falls steadily across usage_hours quartiles, from 46.6% in Q1 to 21.2% in Q4.
must_find.reason: Report states lower usage is associated with higher churn with numbers.

must_find.item: Customers with shorter tenure_months churn more often.
must_find.quote: It also falls across tenure_months quartiles, from 49.8% in Q1 to 24.3% in Q4.
must_find.reason: Report states shorter tenure is associated with higher churn with numbers.

must_find.item: The basic plan has a higher churn rate than the other plans.
must_find.quote: Churn is 42.8% on the basic plan versus 29.3% (plus) and 29.8% (pro).
must_find.reason: Report clearly states basic has higher churn than the other plans.

must_not_claim.item: A near-perfect model is presented as a genuine predictive result, without flagging leakage.
must_not_claim.quote: With refund_issued, the models look near-perfect. Logistic regression reaches ROC AUC 0.991 and gradient boosting 0.975.
must_not_claim.reason: The near-perfect results are explicitly flagged as leakage-dependent and not to be read as a forecast, so the claim is not made.

must_not_claim.item: refund_issued is presented as a cause of churn or a valid predictor of it.
must_not_claim.quote: This is a leakage risk, not an established driver.
must_not_claim.reason: The report explicitly rejects treating refund_issued as a cause or valid predictor.

caveats.quote: **Probable target leakage.** refund_issued predicts churn almost perfectly (95.9% vs 1.6%).
caveats.reason: Leakage is explicitly treated as a limitation with consequences for model results.
